items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: my next trip to Europe was with Nat Cole. I'd made many trips over there with him... I did have a couple of solos with Nat... I would have to do -- to copy the solos that were played by Oscar, and Irving because we would record all these tunes over

ctx.x: Yeah, I didn't meet Linton until we were doing the big show with Nat and Duke, Duke Ellington.
